'''2011 Bespin Regionals Mark Peterson LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' JEEDAI
* '''Username:''' Lukes Bionic Hand
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
